title: Search charges get their own line
summary:
Search billing got more precise, chat got a storage warning, and the app showcase got a little easier to navigate.

Perplexity and Gemini search fees were added alongside token charges. Perplexity aliases use their search-context tiers; Gemini 2.5 charges once per grounded prompt, while Gemini 3.x charges per distinct web-search query and deduplicates repeats across stream chunks.

A community fix adds a warning when a full browser storage quota prevents the chat app from saving image attachments. The warning makes clear that those attachments will be lost on reload.

Flow Linnom, a community-built interface for chatting with multiple language models, was added to the app catalog and showcase. The app submission template now links directly to the review criteria, so contributors can check them before filing.
